concept: HA: Auto Scaling group across multiple AZs behind an ALB
tests: Web-tier architecture for unpredictable spikes with automatic scaling and HA.
expected: Auto Scaling group across multiple AZs behind an Application Load Balancer. Triggers: "unpredictable traffic spikes", "scale automatically", "highly available across multiple AZs".
why_not: A single large instance is a SPOF; a single AZ isn't HA; manual launches aren't automatic.
